title: Network incident triage + dispatch
description: Score live network incidents by network effect, cut a queue that fits available crews, and route severe events to a coordinated response.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-mob-02
  title: Network incident triage + dispatch
  description: Score live network incidents by network effect, cut a queue that fits available crews,
    and route severe events to a coordinated response.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Turn a live incident feed into a ranked, resource-sized response queue where the network
    effect of each mitigation was considered before dispatch.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Live incident and detector feed
      summary: Live incident and detector feed
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - incident_reports
              - detector_state
              - crew_availability
              - event_calendar
            properties:
              incident_reports: {}
              detector_state: {}
              crew_availability: {}
              event_calendar: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-classify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-02
      name: Score incidents by network effect
      summary: Score and label every incoming item before anything is queued.
      role: Traffic operations analyst coordinating signal, incident, and demand response on a network.
      prompt: You are a Traffic & Network Coordinator. You read detector, probe, and incident data as
        a network rather than as isolated intersections, and you predict where a mitigation will push
        congestion before recommending it. You state the equity and access effects of a diversion — the
        route that clears an arterial often moves the delay onto a residential street.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - incident-response
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:its
          - mcp:gis
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - label
          - severity
          - confidence
          - rationale
        properties:
          label: {}
          severity: {}
          confidence: {}
          rationale: {}
    - id: n-filter
      kind: transform
      name: Drop out-of-scope items
      summary: keep incidents inside the managed network that are not already assigned
      config:
        operation: filter
        expression: keep incidents inside the managed network that are not already assigned
    - id: n-rank
      kind: transform
      name: Rank by urgency
      summary: sort by network_delay_impact descending, then by time_since_report descending
      config:
        operation: sort
        expression: sort by network_delay_impact descending, then by time_since_report descending
    - id: n-queue
      kind: transform
      name: Cut the actionable queue
      summary: take the first crew_availability incidents as the dispatch queue
      config:
        operation: slice
        expression: take the first crew_availability incidents as the dispatch queue
    - id: n-severity
      kind: condition
      name: Severity routing
      summary: Route on incident.severity selects one declared branch.
      config:
        expression: incident.severity selects one declared branch
        branches:
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
          - label: Standard
            when: standard
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-escalate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-02
      name: Coordinated network response and diversion
      summary: Escalation path for the top band.
      role: Traffic operations analyst coordinating signal, incident, and demand response on a network.
      prompt: You are a Traffic & Network Coordinator. You read detector, probe, and incident data as
        a network rather than as isolated intersections, and you predict where a mitigation will push
        congestion before recommending it. You state the equity and access effects of a diversion — the
        route that clears an arterial often moves the delay onto a residential street.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - incident-response
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:its
          - mcp:gis
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-handle
      kind: agent
      templateRef: mob-03
      name: Standard dispatch assignment
      summary: Standard resolution path.
      role: Dispatch engineer producing feasible vehicle assignments under hard constraints.
      prompt: You are a Routing & Dispatch Engineer. You produce assignments that respect hours of service,
        vehicle capability, time windows, and depot capacity, and you report which constraint made a request
        infeasible rather than returning a plan that quietly violates one. You give the optimality gap
        for heuristic solutions, because a dispatcher deciding whether to add a vehicle needs to know
        how much is left on the table.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - optimization
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:tms
          - mcp:telematics
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-rejoin
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge after routing
      summary: Release whichever routed path completed.
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Operations supervisor approves diversions affecting the wider network
      summary: Pause for the operations supervisor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Network incident triage + dispatch deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-classify
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-2
      from: n-classify
      to: n-filter
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-3
      from: n-filter
      to: n-rank
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-4
      from: n-rank
      to: n-queue
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-5
      from: n-queue
      to: n-severity
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-6
      from: n-severity
      to: n-escalate
      kind: control
      condition: escalate
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-7
      from: n-severity
      to: n-handle
      kind: control
      condition: standard
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-8
      from: n-escalate
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-9
      from: n-handle
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-10
      from: n-rejoin
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-mob-02-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
